newsitem.title: USA: Endesa board proposes share split.
newsitem.headline: Endesa board proposes share split.

text.p: Empresa Nacional de Electricidad SA, or Endesa, said Tuesday its board of directors will propose at the upcoming stockholders' meeting to split the company's shares outstanding.

The split would reduce the shares' nominal value from Pta 800 to Pta 200, without affecting equity. The current one-to-one ratio of American Depositary Receipts (ADRs) to underlining shares will be maintained, Endesa said.
The proposal will be included in the agenda of the June 25 holders' meeting.
Endesa, a major electric utility company in Spain, said the share split would make the stock more accessible to investors and increase trading liquidity prior to its forthcoming public offering.
